+DeviceVec3 toDeviceVec3(const Vec3& v) {
+    return {v.x, v.y, v.z};
+}
+
+DeviceTriangle toDeviceTriangle(const Triangle& tri) {
+    return {toDeviceVec3(tri.a), toDeviceVec3(tri.b), toDeviceVec3(tri.c),
+            toDeviceVec3(tri.normal())};
+}
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& source, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& triangleIndices, int parent = -1) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = toDeviceVec3(source.center);
+    node.halfExtent = toDeviceVec3(source.halfExtent);
+    node.parent = parent;
+    node.triangleStart = 0;
+    node.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) node.children[child] = -1;
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        nodes[nodeIndex].triangleStart = static_cast<int>(triangleIndices.size());
+        nodes[nodeIndex].triangleCount = static_cast<int>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t index : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+        }
+        return nodeIndex;
+    }
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (source.children[child]) {
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] =
+                flattenOctree(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices, nodeIndex);
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceAdd(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceSub(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceScale(DeviceVec3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return {a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceNeg(DeviceVec3 a) {
+    return {-a.x, -a.y, -a.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceCross(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+            a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+            a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(DeviceVec3 a) {
+    return deviceDot(a, a);
+}
+
+// Counter-based sampling keeps every form-factor pair independent.  It has the
+// same uniform barycentric sampling semantics as the reference RNG, while
+// avoiding a serialized RNG state and making the entire N^2 phase GPU-resident.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sampleIndex) {
+    const uint64_t key = 42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd1342543de82ef95ULL) ^
+                         (static_cast<uint64_t>(sampleIndex) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(randomBits(key)) * (1.0f / 4294967296.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                   val_t u, val_t v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return deviceAdd(tri.a, deviceAdd(deviceScale(deviceSub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                                      deviceScale(deviceSub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(DeviceVec3 p1, DeviceVec3 p2,
+                                                  const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const DeviceVec3 d = deviceScale(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const DeviceVec3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const DeviceVec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(DeviceVec3 orig, DeviceVec3 dir,
+                                                       DeviceVec3 v0, DeviceVec3 v1,
+                                                       DeviceVec3 v2) {
+    const DeviceVec3 e1 = deviceSub(v1, v0);
+    const DeviceVec3 e2 = deviceSub(v2, v0);
+    const DeviceVec3 pvec = deviceCross(dir, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const DeviceVec3 tvec = deviceSub(orig, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const DeviceVec3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(dir, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ int nextOctreeNode(const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                              int nodeIndex) {
+    int childIndex = nodeIndex;
+    int parentIndex = nodes[childIndex].parent;
+    while (parentIndex >= 0) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& parent = nodes[parentIndex];
+        int childSlot = 0;
+        while (childSlot < 8 && parent.children[childSlot] != childIndex) ++childSlot;
+        for (int sibling = childSlot + 1; sibling < 8; ++sibling) {
+            if (parent.children[sibling] >= 0) return parent.children[sibling];
+        }
+        childIndex = parentIndex;
+        parentIndex = parent.parent;
+    }
+    return -1;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlocked(DeviceVec3 from, DeviceVec3 to,
+                           uint32_t sourceTriangle, uint32_t destinationTriangle,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const int* leafTriangleIndices) {
+    const DeviceVec3 direction = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(direction));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const DeviceVec3 directionNormal = deviceScale(direction, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    int nodeIndex = 0;
+    bool root = true;
+    while (nodeIndex >= 0) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        // The host traversal tests a child box before descending into it.  A
+        // parent pointer makes that depth-first traversal stackless, avoiding
+        // a fixed traversal-depth limit and reducing per-thread local memory.
+        if (!root && !rayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+            continue;
+        }
+        root = false;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (int offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex =
+                    static_cast<uint32_t>(leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + offset]);
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                const DeviceTriangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormal, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            nodeIndex = nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        int nextChild = -1;
+        for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                rayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                nextChild = childIndex;
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+        nodeIndex = nextChild >= 0 ? nextChild : nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, uint32_t n,
+                                        int* tau, uint64_t pairCount) {
+    for (uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < pairCount;
+         pair += static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / n);
+        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle& triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle& triJ = triangles[j];
+        const DeviceVec3 centerI = deviceScale(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(triI.a, triI.b), triI.c), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+        const DeviceVec3 centerJ = deviceScale(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(triJ.a, triJ.b), triJ.c), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(
+            sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const int* leafTriangleIndices,
+                                         uint32_t n, val_t* kij, uint64_t pairCount) {
+    for (uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < pairCount;
+         pair += static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / n);
+        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle& triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle& triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (deviceDot(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const uint32_t sampleBase = ray * 4;
+            const DeviceVec3 pI = randomPoint(
+                triI, randomUnit(pair, sampleBase), randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 1));
+            const DeviceVec3 pJ = randomPoint(
+                triJ, randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 2), randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 3));
+
+            if (rayBlocked(pI, pJ, i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices)) continue;
+
+            const DeviceVec3 v = deviceSub(pJ, pI);
+            const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(v);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            const val_t distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(v, triI.normal) / distance);
+            const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(deviceNeg(v), triJ.normal) / distance);
+            if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+            formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         const val_t* radE, val_t* radB,
+                                         uint32_t n, uint32_t time) {
+    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n) return;
+
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t row = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n;
+    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+
+        const uint64_t pair = row + j;
+        const int delay = tau[pair];
+        if (static_cast<int>(time) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[pair];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const uint32_t sourceTime = time - static_cast<uint32_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * n + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(time) * n + i] = rho[i] * sumB +
+                                                radE[static_cast<uint64_t>(time) * n + i];
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, uint32_t n,
+                                       uint32_t timesteps, uint32_t sourceIndex,
+                                       val_t* distances) {
+    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n) return;
+
+    val_t maxCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t time = 0; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t otherTime = time; otherTime < timesteps; ++otherTime) {
+            const val_t receiver = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(otherTime) * n + i];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(otherTime - time) * n + sourceIndex];
+            sum += source * receiver;
+        }
+        if (sum > maxCorrelation) {
+            maxCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(time);
+        }
+    }
+    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+class CudaRoomEngine {
+public:
+    explicit CudaRoomEngine(const SimulationState& state) : numTriangles_(state.numTriangles),
+        numTimesteps_(state.numTimesteps) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+
+        std::vector<DeviceTriangle> hostTriangles(numTriangles_);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < numTriangles_; ++i) {
+            hostTriangles[i] = toDeviceTriangle(state.triangles[i]);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode> hostNodes;
+        std::vector<int> hostLeafIndices;
+        hostNodes.reserve(numTriangles_);
+        hostLeafIndices.reserve(numTriangles_ * 2);
+        flattenOctree(state.octree, hostNodes, hostLeafIndices);
+
+        allocate(dTriangles_, hostTriangles.size() * sizeof(DeviceTriangle));
+        allocate(dNodes_, hostNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode));
+        allocate(dLeafTriangleIndices_, hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(int));
+        allocate(dAreas_, state.areas.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dRho_, state.rho.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dKij_, state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dTau_, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int));
+        allocate(dRadE_, state.radE.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dRadB_, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dDistances_, state.distances.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+
+        copyToDevice(dTriangles_, hostTriangles.data(), hostTriangles.size());
+        copyToDevice(dNodes_, hostNodes.data(), hostNodes.size());
+        copyToDevice(dLeafTriangleIndices_, hostLeafIndices.data(), hostLeafIndices.size());
+        copyToDevice(dAreas_, state.areas.data(), state.areas.size());
+        copyToDevice(dRho_, state.rho.data(), state.rho.size());
+        copyToDevice(dRadE_, state.radE.data(), state.radE.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dKij_, 0, state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dTau_, 0, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dRadB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dDistances_, 0, state.distances.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    ~CudaRoomEngine() {
+        cudaFree(dDistances_);
+        cudaFree(dRadB_);
+        cudaFree(dRadE_);
+        cudaFree(dTau_);
+        cudaFree(dKij_);
+        cudaFree(dRho_);
+        cudaFree(dAreas_);
+        cudaFree(dLeafTriangleIndices_);
+        cudaFree(dNodes_);
+        cudaFree(dTriangles_);
+    }
+
+    void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
+        const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles_) * numTriangles_;
+        computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<cudaBlocks(pairCount), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dTriangles_, static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), dTau_, pairCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.tau.data(), dTau_, state.tau.size());
+    }
+
+    void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
+        const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles_) * numTriangles_;
+        computeFormFactorsKernel<<<cudaBlocks(pairCount), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dTriangles_, dNodes_, dLeafTriangleIndices_,
+            static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), dKij_, pairCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.kij.data(), dKij_, state.kij.size());
+    }
+
+    void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dRadB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        const int blocks = cudaBlocks(numTriangles_);
+        for (size_t time = 0; time < numTimesteps_; ++time) {
+            propagateRadiosityKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                dKij_, dTau_, dAreas_, dRho_, dRadE_, dRadB_,
+                static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), static_cast<uint32_t>(time));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            if ((time + 1) % 10 == 0 || time + 1 == numTimesteps_) {
+                std::printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", time + 1, numTimesteps_);
+            }
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.radB.data(), dRadB_, state.radB.size());
+    }
+
+    void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
+        computeDistancesKernel<<<cudaBlocks(numTriangles_), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dRadB_, static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_),
+            static_cast<uint32_t>(numTimesteps_), static_cast<uint32_t>(state.sourceIndex),
+            dDistances_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.distances.data(), dDistances_, state.distances.size());
+    }
+
+private:
+    template <typename T>
+    void allocate(T*& pointer, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count));
+    }
+
+    template <typename T>
+    void copyToDevice(T* destination, const T* source, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(destination, source, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        }
+    }
+
+    template <typename T>
+    void copyToHost(T* destination, const T* source, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(destination, source, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        }
+    }
+
+    size_t numTriangles_;
+    size_t numTimesteps_;
+    DeviceTriangle* dTriangles_ = nullptr;
+    DeviceOctreeNode* dNodes_ = nullptr;
+    int* dLeafTriangleIndices_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dAreas_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRho_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dKij_ = nullptr;
+    int* dTau_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRadE_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRadB_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dDistances_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+void ensureCudaEngine(SimulationState& state) {
+    if (!state.cudaEngine) {
+        state.cudaEngine = std::make_unique<CudaRoomEngine>(state);
+    }
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA implementation
+// ============================================================================
+
+// The host octree uses pointers and std::vector instances, neither of which is
+// suitable for a device traversal.  These compact, pointer-free records are
+// uploaded once and shared by all form-factor threads.
+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a, b, c, normal;
+};
+
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+    DeviceVec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int parent;
+    int triangleStart;
+    int triangleCount;
+};
+
+namespace {
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n", file, line,
+                 expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                          \
+        cudaError_t error__ = (expression);                                       \
+        if (error__ != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(#expression, error__, __FILE__,  \
+                                                 __LINE__);                       \
+    } while (false)
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_MAX_GRID = 65535;
+int cudaBlocks(uint64_t count) {
+    const uint64_t needed = (count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<uint64_t>(1, std::min<uint64_t>(needed, CUDA_MAX_GRID)));
+}
+
+DeviceVec3 toDeviceVec3(const Vec3& v) {
+    return {v.x, v.y, v.z};
+}
+
+DeviceTriangle toDeviceTriangle(const Triangle& tri) {
+    return {toDeviceVec3(tri.a), toDeviceVec3(tri.b), toDeviceVec3(tri.c),
+            toDeviceVec3(tri.normal())};
+}
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& source, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& triangleIndices, int parent = -1) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = toDeviceVec3(source.center);
+    node.halfExtent = toDeviceVec3(source.halfExtent);
+    node.parent = parent;
+    node.triangleStart = 0;
+    node.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) node.children[child] = -1;
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        nodes[nodeIndex].triangleStart = static_cast<int>(triangleIndices.size());
+        nodes[nodeIndex].triangleCount = static_cast<int>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t index : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+        }
+        return nodeIndex;
+    }
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (source.children[child]) {
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] =
+                flattenOctree(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices, nodeIndex);
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceAdd(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceSub(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceScale(DeviceVec3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return {a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceNeg(DeviceVec3 a) {
+    return {-a.x, -a.y, -a.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceCross(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+            a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+            a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(DeviceVec3 a) {
+    return deviceDot(a, a);
+}
+
+// Counter-based sampling keeps every form-factor pair independent.  It has the
+// same uniform barycentric sampling semantics as the reference RNG, while
+// avoiding a serialized RNG state and making the entire N^2 phase GPU-resident.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sampleIndex) {
+    const uint64_t key = 42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd1342543de82ef95ULL) ^
+                         (static_cast<uint64_t>(sampleIndex) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(randomBits(key)) * (1.0f / 4294967296.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                   val_t u, val_t v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return deviceAdd(tri.a, deviceAdd(deviceScale(deviceSub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                                      deviceScale(deviceSub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(DeviceVec3 p1, DeviceVec3 p2,
+                                                  const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const DeviceVec3 d = deviceScale(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const DeviceVec3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const DeviceVec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(DeviceVec3 orig, DeviceVec3 dir,
+                                                       DeviceVec3 v0, DeviceVec3 v1,
+                                                       DeviceVec3 v2) {
+    const DeviceVec3 e1 = deviceSub(v1, v0);
+    const DeviceVec3 e2 = deviceSub(v2, v0);
+    const DeviceVec3 pvec = deviceCross(dir, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const DeviceVec3 tvec = deviceSub(orig, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const DeviceVec3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(dir, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ int nextOctreeNode(const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                              int nodeIndex) {
+    int childIndex = nodeIndex;
+    int parentIndex = nodes[childIndex].parent;
+    while (parentIndex >= 0) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& parent = nodes[parentIndex];
+        int childSlot = 0;
+        while (childSlot < 8 && parent.children[childSlot] != childIndex) ++childSlot;
+        for (int sibling = childSlot + 1; sibling < 8; ++sibling) {
+            if (parent.children[sibling] >= 0) return parent.children[sibling];
+        }
+        childIndex = parentIndex;
+        parentIndex = parent.parent;
+    }
+    return -1;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlocked(DeviceVec3 from, DeviceVec3 to,
+                           uint32_t sourceTriangle, uint32_t destinationTriangle,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const int* leafTriangleIndices) {
+    const DeviceVec3 direction = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(direction));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const DeviceVec3 directionNormal = deviceScale(direction, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    int nodeIndex = 0;
+    bool root = true;
+    while (nodeIndex >= 0) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        // The host traversal tests a child box before descending into it.  A
+        // parent pointer makes that depth-first traversal stackless, avoiding
+        // a fixed traversal-depth limit and reducing per-thread local memory.
+        if (!root && !rayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+            continue;
+        }
+        root = false;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (int offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex =
+                    static_cast<uint32_t>(leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + offset]);
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                const DeviceTriangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormal, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            nodeIndex = nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        int nextChild = -1;
+        for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                rayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                nextChild = childIndex;
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+        nodeIndex = nextChild >= 0 ? nextChild : nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, uint32_t n,
+                                        int* tau, uint64_t pairCount) {
+    for (uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < pairCount;
+         pair += static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / n);
+        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle& triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle& triJ = triangles[j];
+        const DeviceVec3 centerI = deviceScale(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(triI.a, triI.b), triI.c), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+        const DeviceVec3 centerJ = deviceScale(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(triJ.a, triJ.b), triJ.c), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(
+            sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const int* leafTriangleIndices,
+                                         uint32_t n, val_t* kij, uint64_t pairCount) {
+    for (uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < pairCount;
+         pair += static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / n);
+        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle& triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle& triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (deviceDot(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const uint32_t sampleBase = ray * 4;
+            const DeviceVec3 pI = randomPoint(
+                triI, randomUnit(pair, sampleBase), randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 1));
+            const DeviceVec3 pJ = randomPoint(
+                triJ, randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 2), randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 3));
+
+            if (rayBlocked(pI, pJ, i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices)) continue;
+
+            const DeviceVec3 v = deviceSub(pJ, pI);
+            const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(v);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            const val_t distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(v, triI.normal) / distance);
+            const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(deviceNeg(v), triJ.normal) / distance);
+            if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+            formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         const val_t* radE, val_t* radB,
+                                         uint32_t n, uint32_t time) {
+    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n) return;
+
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t row = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n;
+    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+
+        const uint64_t pair = row + j;
+        const int delay = tau[pair];
+        if (static_cast<int>(time) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[pair];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const uint32_t sourceTime = time - static_cast<uint32_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * n + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(time) * n + i] = rho[i] * sumB +
+                                                radE[static_cast<uint64_t>(time) * n + i];
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, uint32_t n,
+                                       uint32_t timesteps, uint32_t sourceIndex,
+                                       val_t* distances) {
+    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n) return;
+
+    val_t maxCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t time = 0; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t otherTime = time; otherTime < timesteps; ++otherTime) {
+            const val_t receiver = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(otherTime) * n + i];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(otherTime - time) * n + sourceIndex];
+            sum += source * receiver;
+        }
+        if (sum > maxCorrelation) {
+            maxCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(time);
+        }
+    }
+    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+class CudaRoomEngine {
+public:
+    explicit CudaRoomEngine(const SimulationState& state) : numTriangles_(state.numTriangles),
+        numTimesteps_(state.numTimesteps) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+
+        std::vector<DeviceTriangle> hostTriangles(numTriangles_);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < numTriangles_; ++i) {
+            hostTriangles[i] = toDeviceTriangle(state.triangles[i]);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode> hostNodes;
+        std::vector<int> hostLeafIndices;
+        hostNodes.reserve(numTriangles_);
+        hostLeafIndices.reserve(numTriangles_ * 2);
+        flattenOctree(state.octree, hostNodes, hostLeafIndices);
+
+        allocate(dTriangles_, hostTriangles.size() * sizeof(DeviceTriangle));
+        allocate(dNodes_, hostNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode));
+        allocate(dLeafTriangleIndices_, hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(int));
+        allocate(dAreas_, state.areas.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dRho_, state.rho.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dKij_, state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dTau_, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int));
+        allocate(dRadE_, state.radE.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dRadB_, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dDistances_, state.distances.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+
+        copyToDevice(dTriangles_, hostTriangles.data(), hostTriangles.size());
+        copyToDevice(dNodes_, hostNodes.data(), hostNodes.size());
+        copyToDevice(dLeafTriangleIndices_, hostLeafIndices.data(), hostLeafIndices.size());
+        copyToDevice(dAreas_, state.areas.data(), state.areas.size());
+        copyToDevice(dRho_, state.rho.data(), state.rho.size());
+        copyToDevice(dRadE_, state.radE.data(), state.radE.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dKij_, 0, state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dTau_, 0, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dRadB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dDistances_, 0, state.distances.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    ~CudaRoomEngine() {
+        cudaFree(dDistances_);
+        cudaFree(dRadB_);
+        cudaFree(dRadE_);
+        cudaFree(dTau_);
+        cudaFree(dKij_);
+        cudaFree(dRho_);
+        cudaFree(dAreas_);
+        cudaFree(dLeafTriangleIndices_);
+        cudaFree(dNodes_);
+        cudaFree(dTriangles_);
+    }
+
+    void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
+        const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles_) * numTriangles_;
+        computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<cudaBlocks(pairCount), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dTriangles_, static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), dTau_, pairCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.tau.data(), dTau_, state.tau.size());
+    }
+
+    void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
+        const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles_) * numTriangles_;
+        computeFormFactorsKernel<<<cudaBlocks(pairCount), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dTriangles_, dNodes_, dLeafTriangleIndices_,
+            static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), dKij_, pairCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.kij.data(), dKij_, state.kij.size());
+    }
+
+    void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dRadB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        const int blocks = cudaBlocks(numTriangles_);
+        for (size_t time = 0; time < numTimesteps_; ++time) {
+            propagateRadiosityKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                dKij_, dTau_, dAreas_, dRho_, dRadE_, dRadB_,
+                static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), static_cast<uint32_t>(time));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            if ((time + 1) % 10 == 0 || time + 1 == numTimesteps_) {
+                std::printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", time + 1, numTimesteps_);
+            }
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.radB.data(), dRadB_, state.radB.size());
+    }
+
+    void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
+        computeDistancesKernel<<<cudaBlocks(numTriangles_), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dRadB_, static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_),
+            static_cast<uint32_t>(numTimesteps_), static_cast<uint32_t>(state.sourceIndex),
+            dDistances_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.distances.data(), dDistances_, state.distances.size());
+    }
+
+private:
+    template <typename T>
+    void allocate(T*& pointer, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count));
+    }
+
+    template <typename T>
+    void copyToDevice(T* destination, const T* source, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(destination, source, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        }
+    }
+
+    template <typename T>
+    void copyToHost(T* destination, const T* source, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(destination, source, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        }
+    }

+// CUDA implementation

+// The host octree uses pointers and std::vector instances, neither of which is
+// suitable for a device traversal.  These compact, pointer-free records are
+// uploaded once and shared by all form-factor threads.
+struct DeviceVec3 {
+    val_t x, y, z;
+};
+
+struct DeviceTriangle {
+    DeviceVec3 a, b, c, normal;
+};
+
+struct DeviceOctreeNode {
+    DeviceVec3 center;
+    DeviceVec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    int parent;
+    int triangleStart;
+    int triangleCount;
+};
+
+namespace {
+
+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(const char* expression, cudaError_t error,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d (%s): %s\n", file, line,
+                 expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                          \
+        cudaError_t error__ = (expression);                                       \
+        if (error__ != cudaSuccess) cudaFailure(#expression, error__, __FILE__,  \
+                                                 __LINE__);                       \
+    } while (false)
+
+constexpr int CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
+constexpr int CUDA_MAX_GRID = 65535;
+int cudaBlocks(uint64_t count) {
+    const uint64_t needed = (count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE;
+    return static_cast<int>(std::max<uint64_t>(1, std::min<uint64_t>(needed, CUDA_MAX_GRID)));
+}
+
+DeviceVec3 toDeviceVec3(const Vec3& v) {
+    return {v.x, v.y, v.z};
+}
+
+DeviceTriangle toDeviceTriangle(const Triangle& tri) {
+    return {toDeviceVec3(tri.a), toDeviceVec3(tri.b), toDeviceVec3(tri.c),
+            toDeviceVec3(tri.normal())};
+}
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& source, std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<int>& triangleIndices, int parent = -1) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    DeviceOctreeNode node{};
+    node.center = toDeviceVec3(source.center);
+    node.halfExtent = toDeviceVec3(source.halfExtent);
+    node.parent = parent;
+    node.triangleStart = 0;
+    node.triangleCount = 0;
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) node.children[child] = -1;
+    nodes.push_back(node);
+
+    if (!source.triangleIndices.empty()) {
+        nodes[nodeIndex].triangleStart = static_cast<int>(triangleIndices.size());
+        nodes[nodeIndex].triangleCount = static_cast<int>(source.triangleIndices.size());
+        for (size_t index : source.triangleIndices) {
+            triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<int>(index));
+        }
+        return nodeIndex;
+    }
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (source.children[child]) {
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] =
+                flattenOctree(*source.children[child], nodes, triangleIndices, nodeIndex);
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceAdd(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceSub(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceScale(DeviceVec3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return {a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceNeg(DeviceVec3 a) {
+    return {-a.x, -a.y, -a.z};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 deviceCross(DeviceVec3 a, DeviceVec3 b) {
+    return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+            a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+            a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(DeviceVec3 a) {
+    return deviceDot(a, a);
+}
+
+// Counter-based sampling keeps every form-factor pair independent.  It has the
+// same uniform barycentric sampling semantics as the reference RNG, while
+// avoiding a serialized RNG state and making the entire N^2 phase GPU-resident.
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t randomBits(uint64_t key) {
+    key += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    key = (key ^ (key >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
+    key ^= key >> 31;
+    return static_cast<uint32_t>(key ^ (key >> 32));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t randomUnit(uint64_t pairIndex, uint32_t sampleIndex) {
+    const uint64_t key = 42ULL ^ (pairIndex * 0xd1342543de82ef95ULL) ^
+                         (static_cast<uint64_t>(sampleIndex) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
+    return static_cast<val_t>(randomBits(key)) * (1.0f / 4294967296.0f);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ DeviceVec3 randomPoint(const DeviceTriangle& tri,
+                                                   val_t u, val_t v) {
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    return deviceAdd(tri.a, deviceAdd(deviceScale(deviceSub(tri.b, tri.a), u),
+                                      deviceScale(deviceSub(tri.c, tri.a), v)));
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(DeviceVec3 p1, DeviceVec3 p2,
+                                                  const DeviceOctreeNode& node) {
+    const DeviceVec3 d = deviceScale(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const DeviceVec3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), node.center);
+    const DeviceVec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
+    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(DeviceVec3 orig, DeviceVec3 dir,
+                                                       DeviceVec3 v0, DeviceVec3 v1,
+                                                       DeviceVec3 v2) {
+    const DeviceVec3 e1 = deviceSub(v1, v0);
+    const DeviceVec3 e2 = deviceSub(v2, v0);
+    const DeviceVec3 pvec = deviceCross(dir, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const DeviceVec3 tvec = deviceSub(orig, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+
+    const DeviceVec3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(dir, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ int nextOctreeNode(const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                              int nodeIndex) {
+    int childIndex = nodeIndex;
+    int parentIndex = nodes[childIndex].parent;
+    while (parentIndex >= 0) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& parent = nodes[parentIndex];
+        int childSlot = 0;
+        while (childSlot < 8 && parent.children[childSlot] != childIndex) ++childSlot;
+        for (int sibling = childSlot + 1; sibling < 8; ++sibling) {
+            if (parent.children[sibling] >= 0) return parent.children[sibling];
+        }
+        childIndex = parentIndex;
+        parentIndex = parent.parent;
+    }
+    return -1;
+}
+
+__device__ bool rayBlocked(DeviceVec3 from, DeviceVec3 to,
+                           uint32_t sourceTriangle, uint32_t destinationTriangle,
+                           const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                           const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                           const int* leafTriangleIndices) {
+    const DeviceVec3 direction = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(direction));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const DeviceVec3 directionNormal = deviceScale(direction, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    int nodeIndex = 0;
+    bool root = true;
+    while (nodeIndex >= 0) {
+        const DeviceOctreeNode& node = nodes[nodeIndex];
+
+        // The host traversal tests a child box before descending into it.  A
+        // parent pointer makes that depth-first traversal stackless, avoiding
+        // a fixed traversal-depth limit and reducing per-thread local memory.
+        if (!root && !rayIntersectsBox(from, to, node)) {
+            nodeIndex = nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+            continue;
+        }
+        root = false;
+
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (int offset = 0; offset < node.triangleCount; ++offset) {
+                const uint32_t triangleIndex =
+                    static_cast<uint32_t>(leafTriangleIndices[node.triangleStart + offset]);
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceTriangle || triangleIndex == destinationTriangle) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                const DeviceTriangle& triangle = triangles[triangleIndex];
+                const val_t distance = rayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, directionNormal, triangle.a, triangle.b, triangle.c);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            nodeIndex = nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        int nextChild = -1;
+        for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 &&
+                rayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                nextChild = childIndex;
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+        nodeIndex = nextChild >= 0 ? nextChild : nextOctreeNode(nodes, nodeIndex);
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles, uint32_t n,
+                                        int* tau, uint64_t pairCount) {
+    for (uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < pairCount;
+         pair += static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / n);
+        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
+        if (i == j) {
+            tau[pair] = 0;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle& triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle& triJ = triangles[j];
+        const DeviceVec3 centerI = deviceScale(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(triI.a, triI.b), triI.c), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+        const DeviceVec3 centerJ = deviceScale(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(triJ.a, triJ.b), triJ.c), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+        tau[pair] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(
+            sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(const DeviceTriangle* triangles,
+                                         const DeviceOctreeNode* nodes,
+                                         const int* leafTriangleIndices,
+                                         uint32_t n, val_t* kij, uint64_t pairCount) {
+    for (uint64_t pair = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+         pair < pairCount;
+         pair += static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x) {
+        const uint32_t i = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair / n);
+        const uint32_t j = static_cast<uint32_t>(pair - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
+        if (i == j) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        const DeviceTriangle& triI = triangles[i];
+        const DeviceTriangle& triJ = triangles[j];
+        if (deviceDot(triI.normal, triJ.normal) > 0.99f) {
+            kij[pair] = ZERO;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        val_t formFactor = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+            const uint32_t sampleBase = ray * 4;
+            const DeviceVec3 pI = randomPoint(
+                triI, randomUnit(pair, sampleBase), randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 1));
+            const DeviceVec3 pJ = randomPoint(
+                triJ, randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 2), randomUnit(pair, sampleBase + 3));
+
+            if (rayBlocked(pI, pJ, i, j, triangles, nodes, leafTriangleIndices)) continue;
+
+            const DeviceVec3 v = deviceSub(pJ, pI);
+            const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(v);
+            if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+            const val_t distance = sqrtf(distanceSquared);
+            const val_t cosPhiI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(v, triI.normal) / distance);
+            const val_t cosPhiJ = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(deviceNeg(v), triJ.normal) / distance);
+            if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
+
+            formFactor += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+        kij[pair] = formFactor * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void propagateRadiosityKernel(const val_t* kij, const int* tau,
+                                         const val_t* areas, const val_t* rho,
+                                         const val_t* radE, val_t* radB,
+                                         uint32_t n, uint32_t time) {
+    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n) return;
+
+    val_t sumB = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t row = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n;
+    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+
+        const uint64_t pair = row + j;
+        const int delay = tau[pair];
+        if (static_cast<int>(time) < delay) continue;
+
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[pair];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        const uint32_t sourceTime = time - static_cast<uint32_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * n + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity <= ZERO) continue;
+
+        sumB += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+    }
+
+    radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(time) * n + i] = rho[i] * sumB +
+                                                radE[static_cast<uint64_t>(time) * n + i];
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* radB, uint32_t n,
+                                       uint32_t timesteps, uint32_t sourceIndex,
+                                       val_t* distances) {
+    const uint32_t i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n) return;
+
+    val_t maxCorrelation = ZERO;
+    int bestTime = 0;
+    for (uint32_t time = 0; time < timesteps; ++time) {
+        val_t sum = ZERO;
+        for (uint32_t otherTime = time; otherTime < timesteps; ++otherTime) {
+            const val_t receiver = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(otherTime) * n + i];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(otherTime - time) * n + sourceIndex];
+            sum += source * receiver;
+        }
+        if (sum > maxCorrelation) {
+            maxCorrelation = sum;
+            bestTime = static_cast<int>(time);
+        }
+    }
+    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+}
+
+}  // namespace
+
+class CudaRoomEngine {
+public:
+    explicit CudaRoomEngine(const SimulationState& state) : numTriangles_(state.numTriangles),
+        numTimesteps_(state.numTimesteps) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
+
+        std::vector<DeviceTriangle> hostTriangles(numTriangles_);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < numTriangles_; ++i) {
+            hostTriangles[i] = toDeviceTriangle(state.triangles[i]);
+        }
+
+        std::vector<DeviceOctreeNode> hostNodes;
+        std::vector<int> hostLeafIndices;
+        hostNodes.reserve(numTriangles_);
+        hostLeafIndices.reserve(numTriangles_ * 2);
+        flattenOctree(state.octree, hostNodes, hostLeafIndices);
+
+        allocate(dTriangles_, hostTriangles.size() * sizeof(DeviceTriangle));
+        allocate(dNodes_, hostNodes.size() * sizeof(DeviceOctreeNode));
+        allocate(dLeafTriangleIndices_, hostLeafIndices.size() * sizeof(int));
+        allocate(dAreas_, state.areas.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dRho_, state.rho.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dKij_, state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dTau_, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int));
+        allocate(dRadE_, state.radE.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dRadB_, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+        allocate(dDistances_, state.distances.size() * sizeof(val_t));
+
+        copyToDevice(dTriangles_, hostTriangles.data(), hostTriangles.size());
+        copyToDevice(dNodes_, hostNodes.data(), hostNodes.size());
+        copyToDevice(dLeafTriangleIndices_, hostLeafIndices.data(), hostLeafIndices.size());
+        copyToDevice(dAreas_, state.areas.data(), state.areas.size());
+        copyToDevice(dRho_, state.rho.data(), state.rho.size());
+        copyToDevice(dRadE_, state.radE.data(), state.radE.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dKij_, 0, state.kij.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dTau_, 0, state.tau.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dRadB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dDistances_, 0, state.distances.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+    }
+
+    ~CudaRoomEngine() {
+        cudaFree(dDistances_);
+        cudaFree(dRadB_);
+        cudaFree(dRadE_);
+        cudaFree(dTau_);
+        cudaFree(dKij_);
+        cudaFree(dRho_);
+        cudaFree(dAreas_);
+        cudaFree(dLeafTriangleIndices_);
+        cudaFree(dNodes_);
+        cudaFree(dTriangles_);
+    }
+
+    void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
+        const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles_) * numTriangles_;
+        computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<cudaBlocks(pairCount), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dTriangles_, static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), dTau_, pairCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.tau.data(), dTau_, state.tau.size());
+    }
+
+    void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
+        const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(numTriangles_) * numTriangles_;
+        computeFormFactorsKernel<<<cudaBlocks(pairCount), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dTriangles_, dNodes_, dLeafTriangleIndices_,
+            static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), dKij_, pairCount);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.kij.data(), dKij_, state.kij.size());
+    }
+
+    void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dRadB_, 0, state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t)));
+        const int blocks = cudaBlocks(numTriangles_);
+        for (size_t time = 0; time < numTimesteps_; ++time) {
+            propagateRadiosityKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+                dKij_, dTau_, dAreas_, dRho_, dRadE_, dRadB_,
+                static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_), static_cast<uint32_t>(time));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            if ((time + 1) % 10 == 0 || time + 1 == numTimesteps_) {
+                std::printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", time + 1, numTimesteps_);
+            }
+        }
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.radB.data(), dRadB_, state.radB.size());
+    }
+
+    void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
+        computeDistancesKernel<<<cudaBlocks(numTriangles_), CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            dRadB_, static_cast<uint32_t>(numTriangles_),
+            static_cast<uint32_t>(numTimesteps_), static_cast<uint32_t>(state.sourceIndex),
+            dDistances_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+        copyToHost(state.distances.data(), dDistances_, state.distances.size());
+    }
+
+private:
+    template <typename T>
+    void allocate(T*& pointer, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&pointer), count));
+    }
+
+    template <typename T>
+    void copyToDevice(T* destination, const T* source, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(destination, source, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        }
+    }
+
+    template <typename T>
+    void copyToHost(T* destination, const T* source, size_t count) {
+        if (count != 0) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(destination, source, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        }
+    }
+
+    size_t numTriangles_;
+    size_t numTimesteps_;
+    DeviceTriangle* dTriangles_ = nullptr;
+    DeviceOctreeNode* dNodes_ = nullptr;
+    int* dLeafTriangleIndices_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dAreas_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRho_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dKij_ = nullptr;
+    int* dTau_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRadE_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dRadB_ = nullptr;
+    val_t* dDistances_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+void ensureCudaEngine(SimulationState& state) {
+    if (!state.cudaEngine) {
+        state.cudaEngine = std::make_unique<CudaRoomEngine>(state);
+    }
+}
